name: Republic of Klip River
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony). It was located in Transvaal.

name: Republic of Korea
description: Is a country in East Asia that occupies the southern half of the Korean Peninsula. In 1910 whole Korea was annexed by Japan. After Japan's defeat in World War the Korean Pensinsula was divided in a Soviet and an American occupation zone. The U.S. zone gained independency as the Republic of Korea in 1948.

name: Republic of Korea (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by the Republic of Korea that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Republic of Kosovo
description: Is a partially recognised state in Southeast Europe. It unilaterally declared its independence from Serbia on 17 February 2008.

name: Republic of Kruševo
description: A short-lived political entity proclaimed in 1903 by rebels from the Secret Macedonian-Adrianople Revolutionary Organization (IMRO) in Kruševo during the anti-Ottoman Ilinden-Preobrazhenie Uprising.

name: Republic of Kyrgyzstan
description: Was the name of Kyrgyzstan before assuming the official name of "Kyrgyz Republic" in 1993.

name: Republic of Latvia
label: baltic states;separatists (russian civil war)
description: Is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. The Republic of Latvia was established a first time on 18 November 1918 when it broke away from the Russian Empire and declared independence in the aftermath of World War I. At the beginning of World War II it was again conquered by the Soviet Union. With the dissolution of the Soviet Union it gained again its independency in 1991.

name: Republic of Liberia
description: Is a country on the West African coast. It is bordered by Sierra Leone to its northwest, Guinea to its north, Ivory Coast to its east, and the Atlantic Ocean to its south and southwest. Liberia emerged from the union of several private colonies founded by the American Colonization Society (ACS). The ACS was an organization that encouraged and supported the migration African-Americans to Africa. The Republic of Liberia declared independence in 1847, being one of the few countries in Africa that remained indepedent since then.

name: Republic of Lijdensrust
label: boer states
description: Was a short-lived Boer republic in the area of present-day Namibia. It was originally named Upingtonia, but changed its name to Lijdensrust.

name: Republic of Lithuania
label: baltic states;separatists (russian civil war)
description: Is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. The Republic of Lithuania was established a first time on 2 November 1918 when it broke away from the Russian Empire and declared independence in the aftermath of World War I. At the beginning of World War II it was again conquered by the Soviet Union. With the dissolution of the Soviet Union it gained again its independency in 1991.

name: Republic of Logone
description: Is a separatist Republic in the Central African Republic.

name: Republic of Macedonia
description: Macedonia, a landlocked country in Southeast Europe, emerged from the dissolution of Yugoslavia. It became independent after a referendum in 1991. Due to a dispute with Greece, in February 2019 the country renamed iteslf "Republic of North Macedonia".

name: Republic of Madagascar
description: Is a country in Africa that occupies the whole island of Madagascar. In precolonial times the island was fragmented in several polities, Imerina being the largest of them. France united Madagascar into the Colony of French Madagascar by the early XX century. Madagascar gained its indepedency in 1960. Its actual consitution and name were adopted in 1975.

name: Narentine State
description: The Narentines were a South Slavic tribe that occupied an area of southern Dalmatia centered at the river Neretva (Narenta), active in the 9th and 10th centuries. They were defeated and conquered by the Republic of Venice.

name: Republic of Mahabad
label: modern kurdish polities
description: A short-lived Kurdish self-governing unrecognized state in present-day Iran, from 22 January to 15 December 1946.

name: Republic of Malawi
description: Is a landlocked country in Southeastern Africa that was formerly known as Nyasaland. It gained independence from the United Kingdom on 6 July 1964.

name: Republic of Maldive Islands
description: The British Colony over the Maldives ended in 1965 with the independence of the archipelago as the Republic of Maldive Islands.

name: Republic of Maldives
description: Is an archipelagic state in South Asia, situated in the Indian Ocean. It lies southwest of Sri Lanka and India. The archipelago became independent from the United Kingdom in 1965 and was named Republic of Maldives in 1969.

name: Republic of Mali
description: Is a landlocked country in West Africa. A former French Colony, it became indepedent in 1960 and is a Republic since August 1960. Since the start of the Mali War in 2012 the northern portion of the country is fragmented into zones controlled by various rebel groups.

name: Republic of Malta
description: Is an island country in the Mediterranean Sea. It consists of an archipelago, between Italy and Libya. A British possessions since the Napoleonic Wars, it gained independency in 1974.

name: Naro
description: In 1344, the city-state of Uchchakalpa, present-day Unchahara, was founded by Raja Veerraj Judeo when he seized the fort of Naro.

name: Republic of Martyazo
description: Was a short-lived secessionist state proclaimed by Hutu rebels at Vyanda in Burundi in early May 1972.

name: Republic of Mauritius
description: Is an island nation in the Indian Ocean about 2,000 kilometres off the southeast coast of the African continent, east of Madagascar. It gained independency from Great Britain in 1968 and became a Republic on 12 March 1992.

name: Republic of Mirdita
description: Short-lived unrecognized republic declared in northern Albania by Marka Gjoni and his followers. It existed between 17 July and 20 November 1921.

name: Republic of Moldova
description: Is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe. It is bordered by Romania to the west and Ukraine to the north, east, and south. Moldova is one of the countries that emerged from the dissolution of the USSR in 1991. However, the strip of Moldovan territory on the east bank of the Dniester has been under the de facto control of the breakaway government of Transnistria since 1990.

name: Republic of Mountainous Armenia
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: It was established by a military commander and Armenian political thinker Garegin Nzhdeh and his allies with the support of local guerrilla forces, following the suppression of the February Uprising in April 1921.

name: Republic of Mozambique
description: Is a country located in southeastern Africa bordered by the Indian Ocean to the east, Tanzania to the north, Malawi and Zambia to the northwest, Zimbabwe to the west, and Eswatini and South Africa to the southwest. A former Portuguese colony, Mozambique gained its indpendence from Portugal in 1975. It became a Republic in 1990.

name: Republic of Nagorno-Karabakh
description: Was a country in South Caucasus in territories internationally recognised as part of Azerbaijan. The unrecognized Nagorno-Karabakh Republic changed its name to the Republic of Artsakh in 2017 after a constitutional referendum.

name: Republic of Namibia
description: Is a country in southwestern Africa. A former Germany colony, it was occupied by the Western Allies during World War I and then assigned to South Africa as a League of Nations Mandate. Although the mandate was abolished by the United Nations in 1966, South African control over the territory continued despite its illegality under international law. In 1990, South West Africa was granted independence as the Republic of Namibia with the exception of Walvis Bay and the Penguin Islands, which continued to remain under South African rule until 1994.

name: Republic of Nauru
description: Is an island country and microstate in Oceania, in the Central Pacific. On 31 January 1968, following a two-year constitutional convention, Nauru became the world's smallest independent republic.

name: Narsinghpur State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Odisha.

name: Republic of Niger
description: Is a landlocked country in West Africa. It became independent from France in 1960.

name: Republic of North Ingria
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: Short-lived, small state for the Ingrian Finns in the southern part of the Karelian Isthmus, which seceded from Bolshevist Russia after the October Revolution. It ruled parts of Northern Ingria from 1919 until 1920.

name: Republic of North Macedonia
description: Macedonia, a landlocked country in Southeast Europe, emerged from the dissolution of Yugoslavia. It became independent after a referendum in 1991. Due to a dispute with Greece, in February 2019 the country renamed iteslf "Republic of North Macedonia".

name: Republic of Palatinate
description: Was a short-lived unilaterally declared polity in Rhineland-Palatinate during the occupation of German Rhineland.

name: Republic of Palau
description: Is an island country and microstate in the western Pacific. The islands gained full sovereignty in 1994 under a Compact of Free Association with the United States.

name: Republic of Palau (USA)
description: Was an U.S. dependency in the Pacific. Initially part of the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands from 1947, it voted in a referendum against joining the Federated States of Micronesia in 1978 and thus remained under U.S. control until its independency in 1994.

name: Republic of Panama
description: Is a transcontinental country spanning the southern part of North America and the northern part of South America. The separation of Panama from Colombia was formalized on 3 November 1903, with the establishment of the Republic of Panama. The Panama canal zone was controlled by the United States from 1903 to 1979, and was under joint U.S.-Panamian control from 1979 to 1999.

name: Nasiruddin Qabacha
description: Following the death of the first Mumluk Sultan, Qutb al-Din Aibak in 1210, Multan came under the rule of Nasiruddin Qabacha.

name: Republic of Paraguay
description: Is a landlocked country in South America. It is bordered by Argentina to the south and southwest, Brazil to the east and northeast, and Bolivia to the northwest. Paraguay became independent from Spain in 1811, with a larger territory than today. Paraguay lost around one third of its territory to nearby country in the Paraguayan War (1864-1870).

name: Republic of Perloja
description: In November 1918, the locals established a self-governing parish committee, often called the Republic of Perloja (Perlojos respublika), chaired by Jonas Česnulevičius, veteran of the Imperial Russian Army. It was located in modern-day Lithuania.

name: Republic of Peru
description: Is a country in western South America. It is bordered in the north by Ecuador and Colombia, in the east by Brazil, in the southeast by Bolivia, in the south by Chile, and in the south and west by the Pacific Ocean. A former Spanish colony, Peru declared its independency in 1821 but was practically controlled by Chilean and Argentinian troops until 1822.

name: Republic of Peru (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by Peru that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Republic of Poland
description: Is a country in Central Europe. The country is bordered by Lithuania and Russia to the northeast, Belarus and Ukraine to the east, Slovakia and the Czech Republic to the south, and Germany to the west. A Polih nation exist since the establishment of the Duchy of Poland in 961. After a long period of union with nearby Lithuania (1386-1795), Poland was partitioned between Russia, Prussia and Austria. The country was again independent for a short period during the Napoleonic period (Duchy of Warsaw) before being annexed by Russia. It gained its independence after World War I. At the beginning of World War II it was occupied by Germany. The USSR liberated the country and established a Communist regime that lasted until 1989.

name: Republic of Prekmurje
description: Was an unrecognized state in Prekmurje, an area traditionally known in Hungarian as Vendvidék ("Wendic March").

name: Republic of Pskov (Vassal of Moscow)
label: russian principalities
description: Was a medieval state on the south shore of Lake Pskov. Originally a principality and then a part of the Novgorod Republic, Pskov became an independent republic in 1348. It became a vassal to the Grand Duchy of Moscow in 1380.

name: Nasrid Dynasty
description: Was an Iranian Sunni dynasty that ruled Sistan in the power vacuum left by the collapse of the Ghaznavid Empire. In 1194 the dynasty became a vassal of the Khwarazmian Empire.

name: Republic of Rhodesia
description: In 1965, Southern Rhodesia unilaterally declared itself independent as "Rhodesia" under a white-dominated government led by Ian Smith. In 1970 Rhodesia became officially a Republic.

name: Republic of Rwanda
description: Is a landlocked country in the Great Rift Valley of Central Africa, where the African Great Lakes region and Southeast Africa converge. Rwanda emerged as a country in the the XV century. It gained independence from Belgium in 1959 and became a Republic in 1962.

name: Nawanagar State
description: Was a polity in the historical Halar region, located on the southern shores of the Gulf of Kutch.

name: Nayagarh State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Odisha.

name: Republic of Senegal
description: Is a country in West Africa, on the Atlantic Ocean coastline. A former French colony, Senegal became independent in 1960.

name: Republic of Serbia
description: Is a landlocked country in Southeastern and Central Europe, situated at the crossroads of the Pannonian Basin and the Balkans. Serbia emerged in 2006 from the dissolution of the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro, which was the last vestige of the state of Yugoslavia. In this model, Serbia is considered the successor of Yugoslavia because, as in other similar cases, we concluded that Serbia was the core or dominant polity of Yugoslavia because (I) The King of Serbia became the King of Yugoslavia when the latter was created frome the merger of several territories, (II) Serbia and Montenegro were the two independent polities that created Yugoslavia with Serbia being the largest of the two, whereas all the other territories were former Austro-Hungarian territories, (III) What remained of Yugoslavia was an union of Serbia and Montenegro after all other countries had seceded, and again Serbia was the dominant of these two entities. From a legal point of view, the UN does not aknowledge Serbia as the legal successor of Yugoslavia.

name: Republic of Serbian Krajina
description: SAO of Krajina declared itself the Republic of Serbian Krajina.

name: Republic of Seychelles
description: Is an archipelagic state consisting of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean. A former British colony, the Seychelles became independent in 1977.

name: Republic of Sierra Leone
description: Is a country on the southwest coast of West Africa. It gained independence from the United Kingdom in 1961 and became the Republic of Sierra Leone on 19 April 1971.

name: Republic of Singapore
description: Is a sovereign island country and city-state in maritime Southeast Asia. A former British Colony, in 1963 Singapore merged with Malaya, Sarawak and North Borneo to form the independent country of Malaysia. The union was unstable due to distrust and ideological differences between the leaders of Singapore and of the federal government of Malaysia. These culminated in the decision by Malaysian Prime Minister Tunku Abdul Rahman to expel Singapore from the Federation, and on 9 August 1965, Singapore became independent.

name: Republic of Slovenia
description: Is a country in Central Europe. In June 1991, Slovenia became the first republic to split from Yugoslavia.

name: Republic of Somalia
description: Is a country in the Horn of Africa. Somalia gained independency from Italy and the United Kingdom in 1960. The current Republic occured in 1991 duing the Somali Civil War. The northern portion of the country is de facto controlled by the independent Republic of Somaliland since 1991.

name: Republic of Somaliland
description: Is an unrecognised de facto sovereign state in the Horn of Africa, still considered internationally to be part of Somalia.

name: Nayakas of Chitradurga
description: Was a dynasty that ruled parts of eastern Karnataka during the post-Vijayanagara period.

name: Republic of South Africa
description: Is the southernmost country in Africa. The creation of a state in South Africa can be dated back to the establishemnt of the Dutch Cape Colony in 1652. The modern republic was established when the Union of South Africa came to an end with the enactment of the constitution of 1961. An ethnically diverse country, the european minority descended from Dutch and British colonists imposed a regime of racial segregation (Apartheid) that ended in 1994. In the same period, the borders of South Africa did also change considerably: South Africa allowed Namibia to become an independent country, left Walvis Bay (a territory under direct control of South Africa now also part of Namibia), and abolished the "Black Homelands" (or "Bantustans"), territories set aside for Black inhabitants of South Africa and Namibia as part of the Apartheid policy.

name: Republic of South Maluku
description: Was an unrecognised secessionist republic that claimed the islands of Ambon, Buru, and Seram, which make up the Indonesian province of Maluku.

name: Republic of South Ossetia - The State of Alania
description: Is a partially recognised landlocked state in the South Caucasus. It emerged in 1991 from the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

name: Republic of South Sudan
description: Is a landlocked country in Eastern Africa. It gained independence from Sudan on 9 July 2011.

name: Nayaks of Gingee
description: Was a dynasty that became independent after the dissolution of the Vijayanagara Empire. Their territories were located in Tamil Nadu, southern India.

name: Republic of Stellaland
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony).

name: Republic of Suriname
description: Is a country in northern South America. It is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the north, French Guiana to the east, Guyana to the west, and Brazil to the south. The region was colonized by the Dutch from 1667. The country became fully independent as the Republic of Suriname on 25 November 1975.

name: Republic of Swellendam
label: boer states
description: By 1795 the dissatisfaction towards the Dutch East India Company caused the burghers of Swellendam to revolt, and on 17 June 1795 they declared themselves a Republic.

name: Republic of Tajikistan
description: Is a country in Central Asia. On 9 September 1991, Tajikistan became an independent sovereign nation when the Soviet Union disintegrated.

name: Republic of Tamrash
description: Was a short-lived self-governing administrative structure of the Pomaks, living in the Tamrash region of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Republic of Tanganyka
description: A sovereign state, comprising the mainland part of present-day Tanzania, that gained independence from the United Kingdom on 9 December 1961. It became a Republic on December 9, 1962.

name: Republic of Tarnobrzeg
description: Short-lived entity, proclaimed 6 November 1918 in the Polish town of Tarnobrzeg.

name: Ndwandwe Kingdom
description: Was a kingdom in Zululand (South Africa) in the first half of the XIX century.

name: Republic of the Congo
description: A country in central Africa, it gained its independence from France in 1960. It is bordered to the west by Gabon, to its northwest by Cameroon and its northeast by the Central African Republic, to the southeast by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to its south by the Angolan exclave of Cabinda and to its southwest by the Atlantic Ocean.

name: Republic of the Congo (Léopoldville)
description: Was a sovereign state in Central Africa, created with the independence of the Belgian Congo in 1960. From 1960 to 1966, the country was also known as Congo-Léopoldville (after its capital) to distinguish it from its northwestern neighbor, which is also called the Republic of the Congo, alternatively known as "Congo-Brazzaville".

name: Republic of the Gambia
description: Is a country on the Atlantic coast of Western Africa, completely surrounded by Senegal. It gained independence from the United Kingdom in 1965.

name: Republic of the Marshall Islands
description: Is an island country near the Equator in the Pacific Ocean. The islands were conquered by the U.S.A. during World War II. On October 21, 1986, the U.S. ended its administration and the Marhsall islands became independent.

name: Republic of the North Solomons
description: The Republic of the North Solomons was an unrecognised state that purported to exist for about six months in what is now the Autonomous Region of Bougainville, Papua New Guinea.

name: Republic of the Philippines
description: Is an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia. Formerly a Spanish Colony, it became briefly independent in parts of its territories during the Philippine Revolution (1896-1898) but was occupied by the United States during the Spanish-American war (18989) shortly after. The Treaty of Manila in 1946 established the independent Philippine Republic.

name: Negara Daha
description: Negara Daha was a Hindu kingdom now located in the Regency of Hulu Sungai Selatan.

name: Neo-Inca State
description: Was a successor state of the Inca Empire founded to flee from Spanish domination. The Neo-Inca State lasted until 1572, when the last Inca stronghold was conquered, and the last ruler, Túpac Amaru, was captured and executed by the Spanish.

name: Kingdom of Nepal (China Vassal)
description: The short period where Nepal was effectively a Tributary to the Qing Dynasty.

name: Neutral Ground
description: The Neutral Ground (also known as the Neutral Strip, the Neutral Territory, and the No Man's Land of Louisiana; sometimes anachronistically referred to as the Sabine Free State) was a disputed area between Spanish Texas and the United States' newly acquired Louisiana Purchase. Local officers of Spain and the United States agreed to leave the Neutral Ground temporarily outside the jurisdiction of either country. The area, now in western Louisiana, had neutral status from 1806 to 1821.

name: New Grenada Semi-Independent Juntas
label: juntas
description: Were the independent Juntas of modern-day Colombia during the early phases of the Colombian struggle for independence from Spain.

name: Republic of the Sudan
description: Is a country in Northeast Africa. Sudan become an independent sovereign state on 1 January 1956, gaining independence from the United Kingdom. In 2011 the southern part of the country became independent as "South Sudan" after a referendum.

name: Republic of the Union of Myanmar
description: Is a country in Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Bangladesh and India to its northwest, China to its northeast, Laos and Thailand to its east and southeast. The country gained independence fomr the United Kingdom in 1948. The actual denomination was introduced in 2008.

name: Republic of the United States of Brazil
description: The Empire of Brazil became a Republic after the deposition of Emperoro Pedro II in 1889.

name: Republic of Trinidad and Tobago
description: Is the southernmost island country in the Caribbean. It consists of the main islands Trinidad and Tobago. The country gained its independency from the United Kingdom in 1962 and became a republic in 1976.

name: Republic of Tule
description: The Guna indigenous people revolted against the Panamian Authorities and proclaimed the revolutionary Republic of Tule.

name: Republic of Tunisia
description: Is the northernmost country in Africa. It is a part of the Maghreb. Tunisia gained its independency from France in 1956 and became a Republic in 1957. The city of Bizerte initially remained a French possession, but was finally handed over to Tunisia in 1963.

name: Republic of Turkey
description: Turkey is a country that controls most of the Anatolian Pensinsula and a small portion of the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe. The Republic of Turkey emerged after World War I, when it was formally declared on 29 October 1923 as the successor state of the Ottoman Empire. In 2022 the Republic of Turkey changed its official English name to the Republic of Türkiye.

name: Republic of Türkiye
description: Turkey is a country that controls most of the Anatolian Pensinsula and a small portion of the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe. The Republic of Turkey emerged after World War I, when it was formally declared on 29 October 1923 as the successor state of the Ottoman Empire. In 2022 the Republic of Turkey changed its official English name to the Republic of Türkiye.

name: Ngô Dynasty
description: Was a dynasty that ruled over northern Vietnam after putting an end to centuries of Chinese imperial domination in Vietnam.

name: Republic of Uganda
description: Is a landlocked country in East Africa that derives its name from Buganda, a precolonial Kingdom that occupied part of the territory of present-day Uganda. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1963.

name: Republic of Uhtua
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: Was a short-lived state in Karelia duirng the Russian Civil War.

name: Republic of Upingtonia
label: boer states
description: Was a short-lived Boer republic in the area of present-day Namibia. It was originally named Upingtonia, but changed its name to Lijdensrust.

name: Republic of Upper Volta
description: Upper Volta was made a self-governing colony in 1958 as the Republic of Upper Volta, before gaining full independence from France 2 years later.

name: Republic of Upper Volta (France)
description: Upper Volta was made a self-governing colony in 1958 as the Republic of Upper Volta, before gaining full independence from France 2 years later.

name: Republic of Utrecht
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony).

name: Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Is a country located in Central Asia. It emerged form the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991.

name: Republic of Užice
description: The Republic of Užice was a short-lived liberated Yugoslav territory and the first liberated territory in World War II Europe, organized as a military mini-state that existed in the autumn of 1941.

name: Republic of Vanuatu
description: Is an island country located in the South Pacific Ocean. Vanuatu became a shared condominium (the New Hebrides) of France and Great Britain in the XIX century. It gained independence in 1980.

name: Republic of Venezuela
description: The constitution of 1953 renamed the country of Venezuela to "Republic of Venezuela".

name: Republic of Vietnam
description: Was a country that existed from 1955 to 1975 and controlled the southern portion of Vietnam. It was a member of the Western Bloc during part of the Cold War after the 1954 division of Vietnam. Communist forces overran Saigon on 30 April 1975, marking the end of the Republic of Vietnam.

name: Nikapitiya's Rebels
description: In December 1616 a greater revolt broke out in eastern Seven Korales, at the time part of Portuguese Ceylon.

name: Republic of Western Bosnia
description: A small unrecognised state that existed in the northwest of Bosnia and Herzegovina between 1993 and 1995. It consisted of the town of Velika Kladuša (its capital) and a few nearby villages. It was proclaimed as a result of secessionist politics by former Bosnian president Fikret Abdić against the central government of Alija Izetbegovic during the Bosnian War.

name: Republic of Winburg-Potchefstroom
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony). It was located in Transvaal.

name: Republic of Yemen
description: Is a country controlling the southwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula. Yemen emerged from the union of North and South Yemen, on May 22, 1990.

name: Republic of Zaire
description: Was a Congolese state from 1971 to 1997 in Central Africa that was previously and is now again known as the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

name: Republic of Zakopane
description: On October 30, the Organisation officially declared its independence from Austria-Hungary and, two days later, made itself a "National Council".

name: Republic of Zambia
description: Is a country in south central Africa. Zambia became independent from the United Kingdom in 1964.

name: Republic of Zamboanga
description: Was a Republic originated in Zamboanga (Philippines) during the Philippine Revolution.

name: Republic of Zimbabwe
description: Is a landlocked country in Southern Africa, between the Zambezi and Limpopo Rivers. Zimbabwe initally gained its independence as Rhodesia, a country ruled by its white minority. The minority rule ended in 1979. The current Republic of Zimbabwe was declared in 1980.

name: Republic of Zimbabwe-Rhodesia
description: Rhodesia had unilaterally declared independence from the United Kingdom in 1965 to become a white-only governed country. Under pressure from the international community, and due to the ethnical unrest caused by the minority rule, Rhodesia made an agreement with the black community and changed the name of the country into Zimbabwe-Rhodesia.

name: Nilgiri State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Odisha.

name: Republic of Lydenburg
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony).

name: Nizari Ismaili State
description: Under the leadership of Hassan-i Sabbah the Nizari Ismaili created a state of unconnected fortresses in Persia and Syria, surrounded by huge swathes of hostile territory.

name: Republika Srpska
description: Republika Srpska was formed in 1992 at the outset of the Bosnian War with the stated intent to safeguard the interests of the Serbs of Bosnia and Herzegovina. In this period it was practically an independent polity.

name: Nogai Horde
description: Was a confederation founded by the Nogais that occupied the Pontic-Caspian steppe from about 1500 until they were pushed west by the Kalmyks and south by the Russians in the 17th century.

name: Norman State in Brittany
label: norse/viking polities
description: Brittany was occupied by the Norsemen for twenty years.

name: Réunion (Colony)
description: Was a French Colony in the Indian Ocean. The island changed name several times, being called Île Bourbon or Île Bonaparte in the past. It was permanently renamed Réunion after the fall of the July monarchy by a decree of the provisional government on 7 March 1848. In 1946 Réunion became a French overseas department.

name: Réunion (Vichy France)
description: The period of the colony when it was loyal to Vichy France.

name: Revala
label: ancient estonian counties
description: An Ancient Estonian country of the Middle Ages.

name: Northern France
label: barbarian kingdoms;frankish polities
description: In April 879, Louis the Stammerer, Emperor of West Francia, died. The Empire was divided between his sons Louis III and Carloman II with the Treaty of Ribemont (880).

name: Northern France (Louis III) and Southern France (Carloman II)
label: barbarian kingdoms;frankish polities
description: After Louis and Carloman divided West Francia at Amiens in March 880, the two brothers joined to march against Boso, the King of Provence that had secded from West Francia. The conquered territory were administered jointly. However, soon Boso was able to conquer back these territories.

name: Rewa State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Rey Bouba Sultanate
description: Was a precolonial polity in Cameroon.

name: Rhaukos
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Crete.

name: Rhegion
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in Magna Graecia.

name: Rheneia
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient Cyclades.

name: Rhenish Republic
description: Was proclaimed at Aachen (Aix-la-Chapelle) in October 1923 during the occupation of the Ruhr by troops from France and Belgium (January 1923 - 1925).

name: Rhithymnos
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Crete.

name: Rhitten
label: greek poleis

It was the first time in history that Slovakia had been a formally independent state. name: Somali Democratic Republic

name: Somali Republic
description: Was the name given to the newly independent state of Somalia, following the unification of the Trust Territory of Somaliland (the former Italian Somaliland) and the State of Somaliland (the former British Somaliland). The administration lasted until 1969, when the Supreme Revolutionary Council (SRC) seized power in a bloodless coup and renamed the country the Somali Democratic Republic.

It was a short-lived country, being annexed by the Republic of Haiti in 1822. It was the first form of the modern Dominican Republic.

name: Republic of Texas

The rebellion lasted from January 17 to November 6, 1840.

name: Songhai Empire

name: Republic of the Seven United Netherlands
description: Was a confederation that existed from 1579 until the Batavian Revolution in 1795. It was a predecessor state of the present-day Netherlands. The republic was established after seven Dutch provinces in the Spanish Netherlands revolted against Spanish rule, forming a mutual alliance against Spain in 1579 (the Union of Utrecht) and declaring their independence in 1581 (the Act of Abjuration).

name: Sophene

name: Republic of West Florida

It included present-day Colombia, mainland Ecuador, Panama, and Venezuela, along with parts of northern Peru, northwestern Brazil and Guyana. The terms Gran Colombia and Greater Colombia are used historiographically to distinguish it from the current Republic of Colombia, which is also the official name of the former state. Gran Colombia was dissolved in 1831 due to the political differences that existed between supporters of federalism and centralism. It broke into the successor states of Colombia, Ecuador, and Venezuela.

name: Republica de Entre Rios

After the Boer Wars it became a British Protectorate and was one of the states that merged to form the Union of South Africa in 1910.

name: Spanish Protectorate in Morocco

name: State of Israel

Located on the territory of the ancient Kingdom of Israel, it was slowly colonized from the end of the XIX century by Jewish immigrants with the aim of creating a nation there. After World War II the wave of immigration increased further due to the Holocaust. The Palestinian War between the Jewish and Arab population started after the British left their Mandate in Palestine. Israel was officially created in 1948 and was able to conquer most of the the former British Mandate.

name: State of Japan

name: State of Katanga
description: On 11 July 1960, Moïse Tshombe, the leader of CONAKAT, declared the Congo's southern province of Katanga independent as the State of Katanga.

name: State of Kuwait
description: Is a country in Western Asia, located south to Iraq. In June 1961, Kuwait became independent with the end of the British protectorate and the Sheikh Abdullah Al-Salim Al-Sabah became Emir of Kuwait.

name: Sajid dynasty
label: iranian intermezzo
description: An Iranian Muslim dynasty that ruled from 889-890 and centered in Armenia.

name: State of Malta
description: The Crown Colony of Malta became independent under the Malta Independence Act 1964 passed by the British Parliament.

name: Sakti State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Madhya Pradesh.

name: State of North Borneo
description: The territory of North Borneo was originally established by concessions of the Sultanates of Brunei and Sulu in 1877 and 1878 to a German-born representative of Austria-Hungary, a businessman and diplomat, Gustav Overbeck.

name: State of North Borneo (de facto British Protectorate)
description: The territory of North Borneo was originally established by concessions of the Sultanates of Brunei and Sulu in 1877 and 1878 to a German-born representative of Austria-Hungary, a businessman and diplomat, Gustav Overbeck. Unable to attract the interest of the governments of Austria and Germany, Overbeck withdrew in 1879; all his treaty rights with the Sultanates were transferred to Alfred Dent, who in 1881 formed the North Borneo Provisional Association Ltd.

name: State of Palestine
description: Since the 1993 Oslo Accords, the Palestinian Authority officially controls a geographically non-contiguous territory comprising approximately 11% of the West Bank, as well as Gaza. The Palestinian territories are factually divided in two since 2007 when the Palestinian National Authority won the elections in the West Bank and Hamas won the elections in the Gaza Strip.

name: State of Qatar
description: Is a country in Western Asia that occupies the Qatar Peninsula on the northeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula in the Middle East. Qatar as a nation was founded in 1826 by the House of Thani. It was a British protectorate from 1916 to 1971, when it gained independence.

name: State of Qi
label: spring and autumn and warring states periods
description: Was one of many small polities that existed during the Chinese Spring and Autumn Period. It originated before the Zhou Dynasty or at the beginning of its existence.

name: Salghurids
description: Was a dynasty that ruled the region of Fars (Iran). It emerged from the dissolving Seljuk Empire. In 262 it fell under the dominion of the Mongol Empire.

name: State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs
description: Was a political entity that was constituted in October 1918, at the end of World War I, by Slovenes, Croats and Serbs (Prečani) residing in what were the southernmost parts of the Austro-Hungarian Empire.

name: State of Somaliland
description: The State of Somaliland was a short-lived independent country in the territory of present-day de facto independent Republic of Somaliland. It existed on the territory of former British Somaliland for five days between 26 June 1960 and 1 July 1960, when it merged with the formerly Italian administered Trust Territory of Somaliland to form the Somali Republic.

name: State of Syria
description: Was a French mandate that was created by merging the State of Aleppo and the State of Damascus after the dissolution of the Syrian Federation.

name: Sallarid Dynasty
label: iranian intermezzo
description: Was a Muslim dynasty centered on Azerbaijan.

name: State of Vietnam
description: Was a country that controlled the southern portion of Vietnam. It emerged after the decolonization of French Indochina.

name: State of Yue
label: spring and autumn and warring states periods
description: Was one of many small polities that emerged during the Chinese Spring and Autumn Period.

name: Saltukids
description: After the dissolution of the Seljuk Empire, it succeded the Empire in Erzurum (Turkey).

name: STC
description: The Southern Transitional Council is a secessionist faction of the Yemeni Civil War.

name: Samanid Empire
label: iranian intermezzo
description: Was a Persianate Sunni Muslim empire, of Iranian dehqan origin. The empire was centred in Khorasan and Transoxiana, at its greatest extent encompassing Persia and Central Asia.

name: Stielanaioi
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Sikelia.

name: Stiris
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Phokis.

name: Stolos/Skolos
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Chalkidike.

name: Straits Settlements
description: Were a group of British territories located in Southeast Asia.

name: Strandzha Republic
description: A short-lived anarchist commune. It was proclaimed during the Preobrazhenie Uprising in 1903 by Internal Macedonian Adrianople Revolutionary Organization rebels in Strandzha.

name: Sambalpur State
description: Was a kingdom in modern-day Indian state of Odisha, founded in the mid 15th century. The state was placed under British administration from 1818. When the ruler or the state died without a direct male heir in 1849, the British seized the state under the doctrine of lapse.

name: Stratos
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Akarnania.

name: Strepsa
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Chalkidike.

name: Stryme
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Thrace between the Nestos and Hebros rivers.

name: Stymphalos
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Arkadia.

name: Styra
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Euboia.

name: Su
label: spring and autumn and warring states periods
description: Was one of many small polities that emerged during the Chinese Spring and Autumn Period.

name: Sucre Junta
label: argentinian juntas;juntas
description: Was a rebel independent Junta in Bolivia during the struggle for independence from Spain.

name: Sambas Sultanate
description: Was a traditional Malay state on the Western coast of the island of Borneo, in modern-day Indonesia.

name: Sugorsk Principality
label: russian principalities
description: Was one of the many Russian Principalties that existed in the Middle Ages and were later inglobated either into Russia or Lithuania.

name: Suhma Kingdom
description: The Suhma Kingdom was an ancient state during the Late Vedic period on the eastern part of the Indian Subcontinent, which originated in the region of Bengal.

name: Sui
label: spring and autumn and warring states periods
description: Was one of many small polities that existed during the Chinese Spring and Autumn Period. It originated before the Zhou Dynasty or at the beginning of its existence.

name: Suí
label: spring and autumn and warring states periods
description: Was one of many small polities that emerged during the Chinese Spring and Autumn Period.

name: Sui Dynasty
description: Was a short-lived imperial dynasty of China that lasted from 581 to 618. The Sui unified the Northern and Southern dynasties, thus ending the long period of division following the fall of the Western Jin dynasty.

name: Suji
label: african great lakes kingdoms
description: Was one of the precolonial African Great Lakes Kingdoms.

name: Suket Kingdom
description: Was an Indian polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Himachal Pradesh.

name: Suket State
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Himachal Pradesh.

name: Sambuvaraya Dynasty
description: During the 14th century when the Telugu Cholas, Hoysala and Pandya kingdoms went into decline, the Sambuvarayas ruled their territories in the Tondaimandalam region of South India independently.

name: Samma Dynasty
description: Was a medieval dynasty in the Indian subcontinent, that ruled Sindh.

name: Samthar State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Uttar Pradesh.

name: Samtskhe-Saatabago
description: Was a Georgian feudal principality. Its territory consisted of the modern-day Samtskhe-Javakheti region and the historical region of Tao-Klarjeti. As a result of a dispute with the royal Georgian court, the province of Samtskhe seceded. In 1545 Samtskhe became a vassal of the Ottoman Empire.

name: Samudera Pasai Sultanate
description: Was a Muslim kingdom on the north coast of Sumatra. The Kingdom is believed to have been founded by Merah Silu, who later converted to Islam and adopted the name Malik ul Salih, in the year 1267 CE.

name: Sulki
label: phoenician polities;phoenician polities (outside phoenicia)
description: A city-state in Sardinia originated as a colony of the Phoenicians.

name: Sultanat of Goba'ad
description: Was a Sultanate in the Horn of Africa in the XVIII and XIX century.

name: Sultanata of Longone Birni
description: Was a precolonial polity in Cameroon.

name: Sandur State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Karnataka.

name: Sultanata of Tadjoura
description: Was a sultanate centred in Tadjoura (Djibouti) that existed from the XVI century.

name: Sultanate of Agadez
label: hausa states;tuareg polities;berber kingdoms
description: Was a Berber kingdom centered in the city of Agadez in the Aïr Mountains, located at the southern edge of the Sahara desert in north-central Niger. It was founded in 1449 by the Tuareg and Hausa people.

name: Sang Hyang Api
description: A polity on the island of Sumbawa, in the Sunda Islands (Indonesia).

name: Sultanate of Aussa
description: Was a kingdom that existed in the Afar Region in eastern Ethiopia in the 18th and 20th centuries.

name: Sultanate of Bagirmi (France)
description: Was an Islamic sultanate southeast of Lake Chad in central Africa. It became a French Protectorate in 1897.

name: Sultanate of Bambao
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: The Sultanate of Bambao was a precolonial state on the island of Grande Comore. Its capital was the town of Iconi.

name: Sultanate of Bangassou
description: Was a Bandia-Nzakara kingdom in the Central African Republic.

name: Sangli State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Maharashtra.

name: Sant State
description: Was an Indian polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Gujarat.

name: Sultanate of Brunei
description: Was a Malay sultanate on the norther coast of Borneo island in Southeast Asia. It was a predecessor to modern-day Brunei. Whereas modern Brunei is a small country, Brunei was a dominant power of the region that controlled vast territories. These territories were slowly absorbed by other polities, most of them created by European colonists, in particular the Raj of Sarawak.

name: Sape Kingdom
description: A polity on the island of Sumbawa, in the Sunda Islands (Indonesia).

name: Saraikela State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Jharkhand.

name: Sarawak Sultanate
description: Was a traditional Malay kingdom, precursor of the present-day Kuching Division, Sarawak. The kingdom was founded in 1599.

name: Sarbadars
label: persia after the disintegration of the ilkhanate
description: A mixture of religious dervishes and secular rulers that came to rule over part of western Khurasan in the midst of the disintegration of the Mongol Ilkhanate in the mid-14th century.

name: Sultanate of Damagaram
label: hausa states
description: The Sultanate of Damagaram was founded in 1731 (near Myrria, modern Niger) by Muslim Kanouri aristocrats.

name: Sultanate of Darfur
description: Was a pre-colonial state in present-day Sudan.

name: Sardargardh State
description: Was a polity in modern-day Gujarat, India. It became a Princely State of the British Raj in India in the early XIX century.

name: Sarukhanids
label: anatolian beyliks
description: Was one of the Anatolian beyliks, centered in Manisa.

name: Sultanate of Deli
description: Was a malay state in east Sumatra (Indonesia).

name: Saudeleur dynasty
description: Was the first organized government uniting the people of Pohnpei island (in the Caroline Islands), ruling from around 1100 to around 1628.

name: Sultanate of Egypt
description: The British occupation of Egypt started in 1914 and ended nominally with the deposition of the last khedive Abbas II on 5 November 1914 and the establishment of a British protectorate, with the installation of sultan Hussein Kamel on 19 December 1914.

name: Sultanate of Gowa
description: Was one of the precolonial polities that existed on the island of Sulawesi (Indonesia).

name: Savanur State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Karnataka.

name: Saxony
label: barbarian kingdoms;frankish polities
description: Was one of the states that emerged from the partition of East Francia among the three sons of Louis the German in 876.

name: Sultanate of Isaaq
description: Was a Somali kingdom that ruled parts of the Horn of Africa during the 18th and 19th centuries.

name: Sultanate of Itsandra
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: Itsandra was one of the two major precolonial sultanates on the island of Grand Comore.

name: Sultanate of Kano
label: hausa states
description: Kano was a precolonial polity located in northern Nigeria. In the 1350s, after conquering Rano and Santolo, the King made Islam the state religion. Kano from then on became an Islamic sultanate.

name: Savoyard Crusaders
label: crusader states
description: Territories controlled by the Crusaders during the Savoyard Crusade.

name: Sultanate of Lower Yafa
label: southern arabia petty kingdoms
description: Was one of the many Southern Arabia Petty Kingdoms that later became protectorates of the British Empire.

name: Sultanate of Maguindanao
label: barangay states
description: Was a sultanate that ruled parts of the island of Mindanao, in the southern Philippines.

name: Sultanate of Makari
description: Was a Kotoko Sultanate in northern Cameroon.

name: Sultanate of Maradi
description: Was a precolonial sultanate in Niger.

name: Sultanate of Mayotte
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: Was a sultanate on the island of Mayotte, north to Mozambique, that was established when Arabs colonized the island.

name: Sultanate of Mayotte (France)
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: France first established colonial rule in the Comoros by taking possession of Mayotte in 1841 when the sultan signed the Treaty of April 1841, which ceded the island to the French authorities.

name: Sultanate of Morocco
description: Was a Sultanate that ruled over modern-day Morocco. It was founded by the Alaouites, who are the current Royal Moroccan family, after overthrowing the Saadi Dynasty. In 1912 the Sultan signed a protection treaty with France.

name: Sultanate of Morocco (France)
description: Was the territory of Morocco still controlled by the Sultanate but under French protection. In 1912 the Sultan of Morroco signed a protection treaty with France. The French forces slowly occupied the whole territory of Morocco in the period 1912-1919, therefore until 1919 there was a part of Morocco under military French rule (French Morocco) and a part still controlled bey the Sultanate but also under Protectorate (the Sutlanate of Morocco).

name: Sultanate of Muscat and Oman
description: Was a polity in Arabian Pensinsula that emerged when the Omani Empire was divided in 1856 between Muscat and Oman (possessions in Asia and the Arabian Peninsula) and Zanzibar (possession in Africa). It was placed under British protection in 1891.

name: Sultanate of Muscat and Oman (British)
description: Was a polity in Arabian Pensinsula that emerged when the Omani Empire was divided in 1856 between Muscat and Oman (possessions in Asia and the Arabian Peninsula) and Zanzibar (possession in Africa). It was placed under British protection in 1891.

name: Sultanate of Mwali
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: Was a sultanate in the Comoros founded in the XV century that came under French protection in 1886.

name: Sultanate of Mwali (France)
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: Was a sultanate in the Comoros founded in the XV century that came under French protection in 1886.

name: Sultanate of Ndzuwani
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: Was a sultanate in the Comoros founded in the XV century that came under French protection in 1886.

name: Sultanate of Ndzuwani (France)
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: Was a sultanate in the Comoros founded in the XV century that came under French protection in 1886.

name: Sultanate of Nejd
description: Was a monarchy led by the House of Saud, and a legal predecessor of modern-day Saudi Arabia. It was created when Abdul Aziz ibn Saud, Emir of Riyadh, declared himself sultan over Nejd and its dependencies.

name: Sultanate of Ngazidja
label: comoros sultanates;polities of the swahili coast
description: In 1886, Sultan Said Ali bin Said Omar of Bambao united the sultanates of Grand Comore into the state of Ngazidja.

name: Sultanate of Oman
description: Is an Arab country located in Western Asia. It is situated on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula. Oman originated as an Imamate in 750 CE, shortly after the fall of the Umayyads. Oman was able to create an Empire with territories in Africa and Asia. The Empire was divided in 1856 between Muscat and Oman (possessions in Asia and the Arabian Peninsula) and Zanzibar (possession in Africa). Muscat and Oman later became a British Protectorate. It gained independence from the United Kingdom in 1970.

name: Rafai Sultanate
description: Was a sultanate in modern-day Central Africa.

name: Sawantwadi State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Maharashtra.

name: Schleswig-Holstein (rebel government)
description: Was a government created by rebels during the First Schleswig War.

name: Secessionist State of Andronikos III
description: On Easter 1321, Andronikos III fled to Adrianople, where he set up his court and initiated an uprising against his grandfather the Byzantine Emperor.

name: Second Bulgarian Empire
description: The Byzantine Teme (province) of Bulgaria had originated from the conquest of the first Bulgarian Empire one centuriy earlier. The Bulgarians rebelled and created the Second Bulgarian Empire in 1186.

name: Second Empire of Haiti
description: The Republic of Haiti, that had also conquered its northern counterpart, was declared an Empire.

name: Sultanate of Serdang
description: Was an ancient Malay-Indonesian monarchy located in Sumatra.

name: Second Federal Republic of Mexico
description: A federal republic was established again on August 22, 1846 when interim president José Mariano Salas issued a decree restoring the 1824 constitution. During the tenure of the Federal Second Republic, Mexico suffered notable territorial losses: Yucatan and Texas seceded, and after the defeat of Mexico in the Mexican-American War the country was forced to cede present-day California, Nevada, and Utah as well as parts of present-day Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and Wyoming to the United States.

name: Sultanate of Siak Sri Indrapura
description: Was a kingdom that was located in the Siak Regency of Sumatra (Indonesia).

name: Second French Empire
description: Napoleon III, a nephew of Napeloen, abolished the Republic in 1852 and created the Second French Empire. Unlike his uncle, he focused on a series of relatively small wars to increase the French territory. With the Franco-Prussian War the Empire was defeated and France occupied by Germany. After the defeat, Napoloen III was overthrown and the Republic re-established in 1870.

name: Second Republic of Venezuela
description: Was the second independent government of Venezuela, established by Simón Bolívar on 7 August 1813. It was reconquered by Spain in 1816.

name: Seljuk Empire
description: Was a Sunni Mulsim Epire in in Asia, founded and ruled by the Qïnïq branch of Oghuz Turks. At its maximal extent it spanned from central Anatolia to Pakistan. The Seljuks ruled large territories through vassals. In the second half of the XII century the empire quickly fragmented in a multitude of former vassals that gained independence and in successor states.

name: Sena Dynasty
description: Was a Hindu dynasty during the early medieval period that ruled over Bengal and succeeded to the Pala Dynasty.

name: Serb Empire of Jovan Nenad
description: After the Battle Mohács, Serbian General Jovan Nenad drove the Ottomans from Bačka and parts of Banat and Syrmia where he ruled an independent kingdom.

name: Serbian Despotate
description: Was a medieval Serbian state in the first half of the 15th century. A successor of the Serbian Empire and of Moravian Serbia, it was conquered by the Ottomans in 1459. After the demise of the despotate, Serbia ceased to exist as an independent country until the XIX century.

name: Serbian Empire
description: It was established in 1346 by King Stefan Dušan who significantly expanded the territory under his control. It was a successor to the Kingdom of Serbia. The empire controlled most of the western Balkan Peninsula, including most of Greece. The Empire was relatively short-lived as it broke into a multitude of small Serbian principalities after the Battle of Maritsa (1371).

name: Seuna
description: Was a Medieval Indian dynasty, which at its peak ruled a kingdom stretching from the Narmada river in the north to the Tungabhadra river in the south, in the western part of the Deccan region.

name: Sultanate of Ujiji (Rumaliza)
label: arab polities of east congo
description: Was a polity in Tanzania centered on the city of Ujiji.

name: Sultanate of Warsangali
description: A Somali sultanate centered in northeastern Somalia, founded in 1218 AD.

name: Sultanate of Witu
description: Wasa sultanate on the coast of Kenya.

name: Sultanate of Zanzibar
label: polities of the swahili coast
description: Was a polity that controlled Zanzibar and its nearby islands, as well as the coast of Tanzania. It emerged when the Omani Empire was divided in 1856 between Muscat and Oman (possessions in Asia and the Arabian Peninsula) and Zanzibar (possession in Africa). It was placed under British protection in 1895.

name: Sultanate of Zemio
description: Was a precolonial polity on the border of the Central African Republic and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In 1873 it became a Sultanate, but fell to Belgian Congo only twenty years later.

name: Shaddadids
label: kurdish principalities;iranian intermezzo
description: Were a Kurdish Sunni Muslim dynasty who ruled in various parts of Armenia and Arran. In 1075 the dynasty became a vassal of the Seljuk Empire.

name: Shah Mir Dynasty
description: Was the first Muslim dynasty of Kashmir.

name: Sunda Kingdom
description: A Sundanese Hindu kingdom located in the western portion of the island of Java from 669 to around 1579. It was a successor of the Tarumanagara Kingdom.

name: Suppa
description: Was one of the precolonial polities that existed on the island of Sulawesi (Indonesia).

name: Supreme Administration of the Northern Region
label: whites (russian civil war)
description: On 2 August 1918, anti-Bolshevik forces, led by Tsarist Captain Georgi Chaplin, staged a coup against the local Soviet government at Archangelsk and created the Supreme Administration of the Northern Region .

name: Shah-Armens
label: anatolian beyliks
description: Was a Turkmen Sunni Muslim Anatolian beylik founded after the Battle of Manzikert (1071) and centred in Ahlat on the northwestern shore of the Lake Van. Initially a Seljuk vassal, the polity became independent during the fragmentation of the empire.

name: Surakarta Sultanate (Dutch Protectorate)
description: Was a Sultanate in the island of Java. It was established in 1745 by Pakubuwono II. Surakarta Sunanate and Yogyakarta Sultanate were together the successors of Mataram Sultanate. After the Javanese Wars of Succession, it became a Dutch protectorate.

name: Shahpura State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Rajasthan.

name: Surasena
label: mahajanapadas
description: Was an ancient Indian region corresponding to the present-day Braj region in Uttar Pradesh, with Mathura as its capital city.

name: Suren Kingdom
description: Was a Parthian kingdom founded by Gondophares that ruled an area covering parts of eastern Iran, various parts of Afghanistan and the northwest regions of the Indian subcontinent.

name: Shamkhalate of Tarki
label: caucasian khanates
description: Was a polity in the eastern part of the North Caucasus, with its capital in the ancient town of Tarki.

name: Surgana State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was a Princely State of the British Raj in India.

name: Sharifate of Mecca
description: In 1012, the Emir of Mecca Abu'l-Futuh al-Hasan declared himself caliph. The Sharifate controlled the western coast of the Arabian peninsula.

name: Shawomet
label: thirteen colonies
description: Was the second plantation settlement founded by English  colonists on the mainland of Rhode Island.

name: Shilluk Kingdom
description: Was a precolonial kingdom created by the Shilluk people and located along the left Bank of the White Nile River.

name: Suriname (Colony)
description: Was a Dutch colony on the northern coast of South America.

name: Suriname (Constituent County)
description: The Dutch colony of Suriname became a constituent county of the Netherlands in 1954. It gained independency in 1975.

name: Surug
label: aramean polities
description: An Aramaic state on the banks of the Euphrates , founded around 1000 BC.

name: Suzdal Principality
label: russian principalities
description: Was one of the many Russian Principalties that existed in the Middle Ages and were later inglobated either into Russia or Lithuania.

name: Shivpuri State
description: Sirohi State was founded in c. 1311 by Lumbha. It was located in Madhya Pradesh, India.

name: Shun
description: Was a short-lived Chinese dynasty that existed during the Ming-Qing transition.

name: Swan River
label: british colonies in australia
description: Was on of the Colonies founded by the British in Australia. On 6 February 1832 the colony was renamed the Colony of Western Australia.

name: Swat State
label: indian princely states
description: Was a Princely State of the British Raj in India.

name: Siberian Khanate
description: Was a Tatar and Bashkir Khanate located in southwestern Siberia. The Khanate was conquered by the Tsardom of Russia.

name: Swabian League
description: A mutual defence and peace keeping association of Imperial Estates during the Swabian War (1499).

name: Sighnaq Ahmet
description: Was the part of the Kazakh Khanate ruled by Ahmed Khan during the First Civil War of the Kazakh Khanate.

name: Singhasari Kingdom
description: Was a Javanese Hindu kingdom located in east Java between 1222 and 1292. The kingdom succeeded the Kingdom of Kediri as the dominant kingdom in eastern Java.

name: Swedish Rebels
description: Rebel-controlled territories during the War of Deposition against King Hans.

name: Sirmur Kingdom
description: Was an independent kingdom in India, founded in 1616, located in the region that is now the Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh.

name: Swiss Confederation
description: Is a landlocked country located at the confluence of Western, Central and Southern Europe. It is bordered by Italy to the south, France to the west, Germany to the north and Austria and Liechtenstein to the east. It originated as a successor of the Helvetic Republic with the Act of mediation, issued by Napoleon in 1803.

name: Sirohi State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Rajasthan.

name: Syangela/Theangela
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Karia.

name: Sybaris
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in Magna Graecia.

name: Sybrita
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Crete.

name: Syme
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient Dodecanese.

name: Syra (France)
description: Was a League of Nations mandate founded in the aftermath of the First World War and the partitioning of the Ottoman Empire, concerning Syria and Lebanon.

name: Syrakousai
label: greek poleis
description: Syracuse was founded in 734 or 733 BC by Greek settlers from Corinth and Tenea. Initally a colony, it became an independent city-state and a regional power in Sicily, controlling directly or indirectly the eastern part of the island. Syracuse became a Roman ally and vassal during the First Punic War.

name: Syrakousai (Rome)
label: greek poleis
description: Syracuse was founded in 734 or 733 BC by Greek settlers from Corinth and Tenea. Initally a colony, it became an independent city-state and a regional power in Sicily, controlling directly or indirectly the eastern part of the island. Syracuse became a Roman ally and vassal during the First Punic War.

name: Syria (Vichy France)
description: The period of the colony when it was loyal to Vichy France.

name: Syria (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by Syria that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Syrian Federation
description: Was created in 1922 by merging the states of Damascus, Aleppo, and the Alawite state. It was dissolved in 1924.

name: Syrian Kurds
label: modern kurdish polities
description: Collective term for the Kurdish factions in the Syrian Civil War.

name: Syrian Opposition
description: Collective Term for the faction of the Syrian Civil War that opposes the Syrian Arab Republic (ISIS, Islamic Factions, the Kurds and foreign controlled territories are treated separately).

name: Syrian Republic
description: Was the successor of the State of Syria and was created to grant Syria independence. It became effectively independent only in 1946.

name: Syrian Republic (France)
description: Was the successor of the State of Syria and was created to grant Syria independence. It became effectively independent only in 1946. It controlled the territory of modern-day Syria, and, until 1938, the Hatay Province of modern-day Turkey.

name: Syros
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient Cyclades.
